name: sliab
text: sliab names a hill or peak in Celtic speech, the older Irish and modern Scottish Gaelic form. The word opens many place-names across Ireland and Scotland and anglicizes as slieve. The full record of Celtic hill terminology sits under the headword hill.

attributes.attribute: Irish and Scottish Gaelic word for mountain; pointer to hill headword

okr.objective: sliab is a MacKillop signpost for the hill headword.
key_results: Signpost cites hill as the canonical headword.
